Actual passing unit coverage in [quality-policy.test.ts](../../../app/tests/unit/quality-policy.test.ts) includes `AUTO controller reaches STATIC only after three sustained slow windows at each active tier` and `explicit LOW remains authoritative through sustained slow and safe-HOME headroom windows`. These deterministic tests keep adaptive fallback proof separate from the active LOW browser benchmark.
